To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the affective aspects of technology use are very important and that the affective issues are often the same as those identified in the early 1980’s.
learners use learning technologies when they trust the technology to support them to learn and when they trust the learning technologies to support their learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of learning technologies in supporting the development of socio-emotinal skills and the affective aspects of learning.
understanding the affective issues that learners face in using technology and how technology might support their learning.
the role of affective factors in the use of technology for learning, and with technology’s potential to support socio-emotional expression and development in learners.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the research has shown that learners’ use or non-use of technology for their learning has not changed significantly over the last thirty years and that the issues that influence learners’ use of technology are still the same.
the affective issues identified by research into learning technologies are still with us and that they have not changed over the past thirty or so years.
there is still a need to understand the emotional issues surrounding learning technologies, and to develop ways of supporting learners’ emotional needs through the use of technologies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of learning technologies is not just about the technologies themselves but also about the social, emotional and cultural factors that influence their use.

we have found the affective issues of learners’ attitudes and emotional responses to technology and how technologies might support socio-emotive development to be enduring and important issues for researchers and practitioners to address.

the use of learning technologies is influenced by learners’ perceptions and attitudes, and that the development of technologies to support learners’ socio-emotional development is a worthwhile endeavour.
The main takeaway from our work is that
learners’ affective responses to technology are important and that technology has a role in supporting the affective domain in learning.
the factors influencing students’ use of technologies for learning and their affective responses to technology are complex, and that these factors have not changed much over the years.
technology is not the answer to everything, but that it can be used to support learning in many different ways.
